decision.explanation: The question asks who is the president of FIFA. Document d2 (D2S1) states that 'Since his first election in February 2016, Gianni Infantino's presidency has focused on bringing wide-ranging reforms to FIFA,' which directly supports Gianni Infantino as the current president. Document d1 (D1S1) mentions Roger Goodell, but this appears to be an error or confusion since Roger Goodell is the NFL commissioner, not the FIFA president. Document d3 (D3S2) refers to Daniel Burley Woolfall, who was the first FIFA president in 1906, but this is historical and not relevant to the current position. Audit J_A confirms direct support for Gianni Infantino and conflict for Roger Goodell. Audit J_B also confirms Gianni Infantino as correct and rejects the others.
